title: Local Outlier Factor & One-Class SVM
interviewAnswer: LOF compares local density with neighbors, while One-Class SVM learns a boundary around normal data. LOF captures local anomalies; One-Class SVM can be sensitive to scaling and hyperparameters.
keyPoints: Local methods struggle in high dimensions.
Thresholds should be calibrated to alert capacity.
why: Local Outlier Factor & One-Class SVM appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.

LOF captures local anomalies; One-Class SVM can be sensitive to scaling and hyperparameters. Local methods struggle in high dimensions. Thresholds should be calibrated to alert capacity. workedExample: Flag a transaction unusual relative to similar customer behavior even if globally common.
